name: column_stack_out
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::column_stack.out(Tensor[] tensors, *, Tensor(a!) out) -> Tensor(a!). Writes the column-stack result into the keyword-only out tensor, mutates that buffer, and returns the same tensor object and storage. The correctness suite retains the legacy one-, two-, mixed-, and three-dimensional cases, adds scalar and zero-sized inputs, and explicitly checks output contents, shape, dtype, object/storage identity, resize from an empty buffer, accepted safe output casting, and rejection of an unsafe output cast.
